idea: A command-line tool, for developers and note-takers on any desktop OS, that converts Markdown note files into presentation slide decks

marp-team/marp-cli.reason: CLI that converts Markdown files into HTML, PDF, PPTX and image slide decks; ships Windows, macOS and Linux binaries

slidevjs/slidev.reason: Slides written in Markdown, driven from a CLI that serves, builds and exports the deck

webpro/reveal-md.reason: CLI that turns any Markdown file into a reveal.js deck, with static and PDF export; archived

mfontanini/presenterm.reason: CLI that turns a Markdown file into a slideshow, shown in the terminal and exportable to PDF and HTML

maaslalani/slides.reason: CLI that presents a Markdown file as slides, but only inside the terminal; produces no deck file

jaspervdj/patat.reason: CLI terminal presentations from Pandoc-readable Markdown, but terminal-only; produces no deck file

marp-team/marp-vscode.reason: Markdown to slide decks, but as a VS Code extension rather than a command-line tool

marp-team/marpit.reason: Markdown-to-slides framework for developers to build on; a library, not an end-user CLI

genspark-ai/genoffice.reason: AI office suite with a slides editor and a CLI; a desktop app for editing office documents, not a Markdown-to-deck converter

CatchTheTornado/text-extract-api.reason: Extracts text from documents such as PPTX with OCR; the opposite direction
